title: 第七章 夺敌机缘实乃人生一大乐事第八章 人形机缘探测器魔猿遗宝
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
正所谓鹬蚌相争渔人得利，能做渔翁自是不差。
但李玄霄并没有鲁莽出动，而是开始思考这渔翁自己是否能顺利做成。
其中的关键在于两点。
其一，是自己的境界只是天仙，马元身受重伤后毕竟也是玄仙。
不过李玄霄转念一想，自己如今可是身负两件先天灵宝，洪荒世界，境界重要，可神通术法、灵宝神兵亦是决定实际战力的重要因素！
其二，这马元是杀是留？
李玄霄心中思虑一番，微微摇头，这马元尚不可杀。
倒不是李玄霄圣母，只是还有一层同门关系，且更重要的是马元最擅长钻山打洞找偏门机缘。
而自己有宿敌录，每次马元找到机缘，宿敌录都会提前预示。
杀了他，反倒断了这条源源不断的机缘路子；留着他，日后他找一次机缘，自己就能截胡一次，不停地薅他羊毛，这是稳赚不赔！
但是这就又有一个问题。
要想一直薅他羊毛，最好得隐蔽身份，这般才能细水长流。
这说来也巧，李玄霄还有一面神秘古镜，可隐藏自身气息……
去，必须去！
必夺了那马元的这番机缘！
李玄霄心中主意已定，没有半分拖沓，借助古镜遮掩气机，随后展开风雷双翅，巽风鼓动，便出了金鳌岛，直奔北方的血岭岛而去。
血岭岛地处东海之北的一处荒僻海域，岛上遍布血岩，煞气浓重。
李玄霄没有贸然入岛，先是散开一缕细如发丝的神识伴着呼啸的海风，贴着海面扫过血岭岛。
果然，岛屿中心的山腹山洞内，散发出通臂魔猿那濒死却依旧厚重的太乙金仙气息。
而山洞西侧的断崖夹缝里，还有一道玄仙气息正死死蛰伏着，自当就是那马元了！

李玄霄无声一笑，风雷双翅微微煽动，海风吹过，亦是悄无声息地潜入岛内，亦选了一处距离山洞百丈左右的山壁缝隙，彻底收敛了所有气息。
接下来，便是静待时机！
等到马元再也忍不住的时候，拼尽全力去耗死通臂魔猿，也把自己耗得油尽灯枯，他再出手，坐收渔翁之利。
这日深夜，血岭岛狂风呼啸，漫天煞气被海风卷得翻涌，正是偷袭动手的绝佳时机！
蛰伏了半月的马元，终于动了。
他整个人化作一道淡不可察的暗影，悄无声息地滑到山腹山洞前，看着那垂危的通臂魔猿，马元脸上露出狰狞的笑意。
为了这一刻，他足足隐忍了半个月，日日观察魔猿的状态，就等对方伤势最重、煞气攻心的时刻，一击得手！
“通臂魔猿的本源魔臂！还有身上的灵宝……全都是道爷的了！”
马元心中狂念，手中早已备好的压箱底的手段——一道血煞破体符被果断打出！
这符箓来之不易，亦是他敢谋划这重伤太乙金仙躯体的底气来源。
而那通臂魔猿庞大的身躯蜷缩在石台上，浑身金色猿毛焦枯脱落，胸口一道贯穿伤深可见骨，巫族的煞毒已经蔓延至心脉，连那能撕金裂石的通臂，正无力地垂着。
感知到危险的他猛地睁开铜铃大的双眼，猩红的眸子里爆发出滔天怒火。
“区区玄仙境蝼蚁，也敢觊觎本座？找死！”
哪怕濒死，他也是太乙金仙境界的妖族大将，岂容一个玄仙蝼蚁放肆？
content_en:
As the saying goes, the snipe and the clam compete for the fisherman's profit, so it's not bad to be a fisherman.
But Li Xuanxiao did not act recklessly, but began to think about whether the fisherman himself could successfully accomplish it.
The key lies in two points.
First, his own realm is only that of a heavenly immortal, and Ma Yuan is still a mysterious immortal after being seriously injured.
However, Li Xuanxiao then thought about it and realized that he was now carrying two innate spiritual treasures. In the prehistoric world, realm was important, but magical powers, magic arts, spiritual treasures and weapons were also important factors in determining actual combat power!
Secondly, should Ma Yuan be killed or retained?
Li Xuanxiao thought for a while and shook his head slightly. This Ma Yuan cannot be killed yet.
She is not the Holy Mother of Li Xuanxiao, but she still has a relationship with the same sect, and more importantly, Ma Yuan is the best at drilling holes in mountains to find opportunities.
And he has an old enemy record. Every time Ma Yuan finds an opportunity, the old enemy record will predict it in advance.
Killing him will cut off this endless path of opportunity; keep him, and if he finds an opportunity in the future, he can cut off his beard once and keep picking out his wool. This is a sure profit!
But there's another problem.
If you want to keep plundering his wool, it's best to hide your identity, so that the flow of money can flow smoothly.
It's a coincidence that Li Xuanxiao also has a mysterious ancient mirror that can hide his own aura...
Go, must go!
I will definitely seize this opportunity of that horse yuan!
Li Xuanxiao had made up his mind, and without any delay, he used the ancient mirror to conceal his energy, then spread out his wind and thunder wings, and with the Xun wind blowing, he left Jin'ao Island and headed straight to Xueling Island in the north.
Blood Ridge Island is located in a remote sea area in the north of the East China Sea. The island is covered with blood rocks and is filled with evil spirits.
Li Xuanxiao did not enter the island rashly, but first spread out a strand of divine consciousness as thin as a hair, accompanied by the roaring sea wind, and swept across the Xueling Island along the sea surface.
Sure enough, the cave on the mountainside in the center of the island exudes the Taiyi Golden Immortal aura of the dying but still thick Taiyi Golden Immortal.
And in the gap between the cliffs on the west side of the cave, there is a mysterious aura dormant, it must be that Ma Yuan!
Li Xuanxiao smiled silently, Feng Lei's wings fluttered slightly, and the sea breeze blew by, and he quietly sneaked into the island. He also chose a gap in the mountain wall about a hundred feet away from the cave, and completely restrained all his aura.
The next step is to wait for the opportunity!
When Ma Yuan couldn't bear it any longer, he tried his best to kill the Demon Ape, and also exhausted himself. Then he took action again and reaped the benefits.
Late that night, the wind was howling on Xueling Island, and the evil spirit in the sky was swept up by the sea breeze. It was the perfect time to launch a sneak attack!
Ma Yuan, who had been dormant for half a month, finally moved.
His whole body turned into an invisible shadow, and he slid silently to the cave in the middle of the mountain. Looking at the dying thong-armed demon ape, Ma Yuan showed a ferocious smile on his face.
For this moment, he had endured for half a month, observing the condition of the demonic ape every day, waiting for the moment when the opponent was most seriously injured and the evil spirit struck his heart, and succeeded with one blow!
"The original magic arm of the through-armed demon ape! And the spiritual treasures on it...all belong to the Taoist master!"
Ma Yuan was thinking wildly in his heart, and he had already prepared the means to suppress the bottom of the box - a blood-shattering body-breaking talisman was decisively shot out!
This talisman was hard-won, and it was also the source of his confidence to plan this serious injury to Taiyi Jinxian's body.
And the huge body of the through-armed demon ape was curled up on the stone platform. The golden ape hair all over its body was withered and peeled off. A penetrating wound on the chest was so deep that the bones were visible. The evil poison of the witch clan had spread to the heart, and even the through-arm, which could tear gold and crack stone, was hanging feebly.
Sensing the danger, he suddenly opened his copper-bell-sized eyes, and his scarlet eyes burst out with monstrous rage.
"A mere ant in the Mysterious Immortal Realm dares to covet me? I'm looking for death!"
Even if he is on the verge of death, he is still a general of the demon clan in the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm. How can he allow a mysterious ant to act recklessly?
